sales_payment_details.name: sales_payment_details
sales_payment_details.value:
("sales"."payment_method" = 'cash' and "sales"."cash_received" >= "sales"."total" and "sales"."gcash_ref" is null)
        or ("sales"."payment_method" = 'gcash' and "sales"."gcash_ref" ~ '^[0-9]{13}$')

users_pharmacist_license.name: users_pharmacist_license
users_pharmacist_license.value: "users"."position" is distinct from 'pharmacist' or "users"."prc_license_no" is not null
